content: bwmarrin/snowflake issue tracker: clock rollback duplicates confirmed in the wild (issue #20 wall-clock dupes fixed via PR #18 monotonic clock; PR #53 open 2023 reports 149 dup IDs after 5ms rollback in cloud-native env; PR #69 open 2026 notes restart-time skew undetectable by monotonic clock). Meituan Leaf tech blog: 2017 leap second caused real clock rollback on production machines, mitigated by startup time-vs-ZK check and <=5ms wait-2x / else throw strategy. Cloudflare 2017 leap second: Go code assuming time monotonic panicked (rand.Int63n negative) causing DNS outage.
